comparison_method.raw: Compare parsed JSON objects by schema name and operations by HTTP method and path, ignoring key order. Webhook operations are counted independently from paths.
comparison_method.diagnostic_normalization: The raw comparison retains all changes. Contract paths ignore documentation/annotation keys, required-array order and an equivalent conversion from a one-value enum to const. Remaining differences require review and may also include codegen metadata or allOf reorganization.
comparison_method.record_hash: SHA-256 of the record payload serialized as UTF-8 JSON with sorted object keys and no insignificant separators.
comparison_method.scope: The inventory assigns primary review ownership for the fixed snapshot. Dispositions describe planning evidence and do not claim implemented behavior.
